text: 创业板指、科创50指数均跌超1%，沪指跌0.32%，创业板指跌0.66%，贵金属、煤炭、军工、航运等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近3200只
text_en: ChiNext Index and STAR 50 Index both fall over 1%; Shanghai Composite down 0.32%, ChiNext down 0.66%; precious metals, coal, defense, and shipping lead declines; nearly 3,200 stocks fall across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
